articles.title: Windows 11 24H2 Support Has Ended: What to Do Now and How to Upgrade Safely
articles.subtitle: What Windows 11 24H2 end of support means for your device, how to check your current build, and step-by-step instructions to upgrade safely.
articles.excerpt: Everything you need to know about Windows 11 24H2 reaching end of servicing: security risks, compatibility checks, and how to upgrade safely without losing files.
articles.metaTitle: Windows 11 24H2 Support Has Ended: What to Do Now and How to Upgrade Safely | Zee Writes
articles.metaDescription: Windows 11 24H2 support has ended. Follow this step-by-step guide to verify your build, backup your files, and upgrade safely to the latest supported release.

coverImage.alt: Windows 11 24H2 Upgrade and Security Servicing Lifecycle Guide
coverImage.caption: Step-by-step Windows 11 servicing lifecycle and safe in-place upgrade path.

verifiedTakeaway.symptom: Windows Update displays 'Your device is nearing the end of service' or stops receiving monthly cumulative security patches.
verifiedTakeaway.rootCause: Microsoft enforces servicing timelines for Windows 11 feature updates. When a build reaches its retirement date, cumulative security updates and technical assistance cease.
verifiedTakeaway.instantFix: Verify hardware compatibility, create a system restore point, and run the official Windows Update Assistant or in-place upgrade.

howToSteps.name: Check Your Current Windows 11 Build
howToSteps.text: Press Windows Key + R, type winver in the Run dialog, and press Enter. Confirm whether your version reads Version 24H2 and note your OS Build number.
howToSteps.proTip: You can also open PowerShell and run: Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' | Select-Object DisplayVersion, CurrentBuild

howToSteps.name: Create a System Restore Point & Backup
howToSteps.text: Before upgrading, ensure your important files are backed up to an external drive or cloud storage. Open Create a restore point from the Start menu and click Create.
howToSteps.proTip: Having a recent restore point ensures you can roll back within 10 days if any third-party driver conflicts occur.

howToSteps.name: Trigger the Official Upgrade via Windows Update
howToSteps.text: Navigate to Settings > Windows Update and click Check for updates. If the next feature update is ready for your hardware, click Download & install.
howToSteps.proTip: Ensure you have at least 20 GB of free drive space on your C: drive before starting the installation.

howToSteps.name: Verify Installation and Enable Secure Baseline
howToSteps.text: After the system restarts and finishes the upgrade, open Settings > System > About to confirm your new Windows version and verify that Windows Security shows all green checks.

sections.heading: 1. What Does Windows 11 24H2 End of Support Mean?
paragraphs: When a Windows 11 version reaches its End of Servicing date, Microsoft no longer provides monthly security intelligence updates, bug fixes, or technical support for that specific build.

While your PC will continue to boot and run installed applications normally, it becomes progressively more vulnerable to newly discovered zero-day exploits and malware that target unpatched kernel vulnerabilities.

callout.title: Security Warning
callout.body: Running an unserviced operating system on a network exposes your local credentials, browser sessions, and stored data to unpatched remote-code execution vulnerabilities.

sections.heading: 2. Recommended Action Plan for Users
paragraphs: The safest and most reliable course of action is to perform an in-place upgrade to the latest supported Windows 11 feature update. In-place upgrades preserve all your personal files, desktop settings, and installed applications while replacing the core system files with the latest secure build.
Ensure your device meets the standard Windows 11 hardware baseline: TPM 2.0 enabled in UEFI BIOS, Secure Boot active, and at least 64 GB of total system storage.

sections.heading: 3. Troubleshooting Common Upgrade Blockers
paragraphs: If Windows Update fails with error codes such as 0x80070070 (insufficient disk space) or 0xC1900101 (driver conflict), run the built-in Windows Update Troubleshooter and temporarily disconnect external USB peripherals.
You can reset the Windows Update cache by stopping the update services, clearing the SoftwareDistribution folder, and restarting the service.

codeBlock.code:
net stop wuauserv
net stop cryptSvc
net stop bits
ren C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution SoftwareDistribution.old
net start wuauserv
net start cryptSvc
net start bits

faqs.question: Will my computer stop working after Windows 11 24H2 support ends?
faqs.answer: No, your computer will not suddenly shut down or stop functioning. However, it will no longer receive monthly cumulative security patches from Microsoft, leaving it vulnerable to new security threats.

faqs.question: Is upgrading to the next supported Windows 11 release free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Feature updates for Windows 11 are completely free for all licensed Windows 11 users through Windows Update.

faqs.question: Will upgrading delete my files, games, or applications?
faqs.answer: A standard in-place update through Windows Update or the official Update Assistant retains all of your personal files, desktop icons, browser bookmarks, and installed software.
